name: Content-Topology-First Second-Family Divergence
purpose: Attempt one genuinely distinct second visual family while preventing a representation law from surviving merely by repeating one causal/content staging. Content/cause topology is frozen before representation premises, and transfer forces a different topology.
bounded_question: Can a fresh whole-surface representation law remain materially distinct from the current provisional family and VFD-01 premises while preserving human, relational, causal, epistemic and accessibility laws across two pre-frozen materially disjoint content/cause topologies?
stage_order: A_TOPOLOGY_FREEZE: construct T1-T4 only; no representation premise may exist.
B_PREMISE_FREEZE: after A is immutable, construct R1-R4 as representation laws without topology-specific objects, poses, architecture or signature motifs.

C_INPUT_FREEZE: combine exact frozen topology packets and premise laws using the predeclared assignment; freeze all primary and all possible transfer renderer-visible packets before any image generation.
D_PRIMARY: generate/evaluate at most four primary images.
E_TRANSFER: at most two primary survivors receive one transfer each under the predeclared different topology.
F_CLOSE: zero transfer survivors closes CTF-01; any survivor stops at Director convergence review. No automatic Phase C.

topology_contract.definition: A topology class specifies only the causal relation structure of the neutral present situation: earlier durable human action, current shared-condition change, actor dependency/access/use consequence, spatial relation class, recoverable evidence carrier and restoration counterfactual. It must not specify an art style or representation ontology.
topology_contract.pairwise_floor: Every topology pair must differ materially on at least four of six axes. Surface changes such as era, location, camera, props, profession, weather or palette do not count.
topology_contract.anti_motif: No two topology packets may share the same dominant barrier/partition, worker-manipulating-units, before/after residue motif, pose topology, object family, or architecture shorthand. VFD-01 primary/transfer barrier-worker-standing-person topology is specifically quarantined as diagnostic evidence, not a topology seed.
topology_contract.rejection: All four topology slots must satisfy the pairwise floor. If any slot fails, CTF-01 terminates before premise construction with zero family survivors and no replacement topology; this preserves the predeclared primary/transfer assignment without result-aware remapping.

premise_contract.construction_timing: R1-R4 do not exist until T1-T4 are frozen and audited.
premise_contract.content: Each premise positively defines representation ontology, spatial/relational visual grammar, figure-ground/material-edge grammar, human-specificity mechanism, consequence/history carrier and tonal/texture atmosphere logic without naming any topology-specific object, pose, architecture or scenario.
premise_contract.pairwise_floor: Every surviving premise pair differs materially on at least four of six axes.
premise_contract.quarantine: No R premise may use or cosmetically rename VFD-01 P1 accumulated-mark field, P2 interlocking-plane field, P3 diffused-density continuum, P4 rule-bearing mosaic/discrete-unit field, or the current C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT family as a construction seed.
premise_contract.rejection: A premise failing pairwise distance or quarantine is rejected before rendering and not replaced.

assignment.law: Mapping is frozen before topology/premise content exists. Transfer topology is always different from primary and separated by a two-slot derangement; no result-aware reassignment.

construction_quarantine.vfd01: All VFD-01 P1-P4 laws, packets, images, props, architecture, pose/staging and mosaic result are diagnostic/falsification controls only. They may not appear in renderer-visible construction inputs or seed premise/topology design.
construction_quarantine.current_family: C0 Threshold K, O3, TYP-02 F1, MAT F1, STA F2, MOT F1A/CS2 and CLR evidence are later comparison controls only.
construction_quarantine.historical: Exact VID/hero/Quiet Stage/Mineral Theater imagery, casts, props, architecture and compositions carry no inheritance rights.
construction_quarantine.comparison_timing: Visual comparison against quarantined evidence occurs only after all topology, premise and possible renderer-visible packets are frozen; comparison may falsify but never edit them.

controlled_neutralities: No project/product/brand names, marks, wordmark, bespoke typography, UI, website layout, semantic icons or product-state semantics in scored images.
Color is incidental only and cannot be the organizing identity axis.
No generated image becomes production/hero/app/site master by survival.

probe_budget.primary_rule: Exactly one judgeable primary image per eligible R/T primary pairing. No reroll or alternate seed after viewing.
probe_budget.transfer_rule: At most two primary survivors receive exactly one transfer image under the frozen transfer mapping.
probe_budget.technical_failure: A genuine no-image technical failure may retry only with byte-identical inputs and creates no design evidence.
probe_budget.no_hidden_budget: No fifth topology, fifth premise, calibration render, result-aware reassignment or free replacement.

renderer_isolation.context_rule: Every probe runs in a fresh regular non-project renderer context with no earlier CTF/VFD/current-family image or project conversation.
renderer_isolation.input_rule: Renderer sees only the exact premise law plus exact assigned topology packet and generic output instruction. No critique/history/comparison/project name.
renderer_isolation.output_rule: One artwork only; no rank, explanation, revision or alternatives. Judgeable output consumes the slot.
renderer_isolation.preservation_rule: Preserve returned bytes/provenance before evaluation where available; record custody limits truthfully.
renderer_isolation.no_cross_probe_memory: Later probes inherit only frozen text law, never prior pixels.

primary_survival_gates: ARTISTIC_INTEGRITY: coherent authored visual world, not diagram/moodboard/generic product illustration.
HUMAN_PRIMACY: people are specific causal/relational participants, not scale figures.
TOPOLOGY_FIDELITY: image visibly instantiates its assigned frozen causal topology without substituting another simpler topology.
RELATIONAL_TRUTH: current relation follows from visible changed condition without explanatory graphics.
EPISTEMIC_RESTRAINT: no private intent/belief/memory is asserted.
WHOLE_SURFACE_SPECIFICITY: affirmative repeatable representation grammar beyond one motif.
PREMISE_QUARANTINE_PASS: no material reuse of VFD-01 premise ontology or current/historical construction seed.
DISTANCE_PASS: after frozen comparison, materially different from current provisional family on at least four of six representation axes.
ACCESSIBILITY_TRANSFER_POTENTIAL: essential people/relation/condition do not depend solely on hue, micro-detail, text, motion or wide-only positioning.
transfer_survival_gates: All primary gates remain satisfied under the assigned different topology.
TOPOLOGY_CHANGE_PASS: transfer instantiates the frozen transfer topology, not the primary topology under new scenery.
GRAMMAR_TRANSFER_PASS: representation family remains recognizable without copying primary composition, props, architecture, pose topology or signature motif.
ANTI_COPY_PASS: no dominant primary causal staging/signature motif recurs even if the renderer independently chooses it.
HUMAN_AND_RELATIONAL_TRANSFER: specificity and causal relation survive the new topology.
NO_COLLAPSE: transfer does not collapse to current provisional family, a VFD premise, or quarantined historical surface.

selection_and_termination.primary_shortlist: At most two primary survivors. Prefer strongest topology fidelity + whole-surface repeatability + distance. If >2 are evidence-tied and cut is irreducibly aesthetic, stop for Director choice.
selection_and_termination.family_survivor: One R family survives only if both its primary and transfer pass every conjunctive gate.
selection_and_termination.zero_transfer: Close CTF-01 zero-survivor; preserve mechanism/topology evidence only.
selection_and_termination.one_or_more_transfer: Stop CTF-01 and present surviving second-family evidence at Director convergence review. Phase C remains non-automatic.

next_action: Open one serial CTF-01 branch from this exact method checkpoint. Construct and freeze T1-T4 plus their pairwise audit first. Only after that freeze may R1-R4 be constructed.
audit_result: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN PRE-EXPOSURE METHOD FREEZE.
